### Soil Bioengineering in Tropical Regions {.card-title}

**Fundamentals, Techniques and Applications**

Technical-scientific manual on soil bioengineering applied to tropical regions, covering soil formation fundamentals and erosion to stabilization techniques with living materials and innovations in geotextiles and superabsorbent biopolymers.

- **21 chapters** organized in 4 parts
- Equations, sizing tables and case studies
- CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 License
